- "Covered": the slides commit to ALL parts of the requirement. Different wording is fine.
- "Partially covered": the slides commit to SOME parts, but at least one part is missing.
- "Not covered":

response.evidence:
Build a comprehensive long-list of 25+ AI opportunities spanning the entire enterprise footprint.
- Score each opportunity rigorously based on business value versus ease of implementation.
- Size each AI play with an indicative EBITDA uplift model
